entry.title: New: BILL065(26) (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Amends the requirements for the historic residential real property dedicated for preservation exemption to provide that historic residential real property may not be used as a transient vacation unit. Applies to tax years beginning July 1, 2028; provided that historic residential real properties that have already been approved prior to the effective date of the ordinance will continue for the duration of the approved or renewed 10-year period, but may only be renewed if such properties comply with ROH Section 8-10.19 as it reads on the date of renewal.

entry.title: BILL053(26) (Honolulu): CCL/PH → PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO SHOPPING CARTS.

Generally prohibits possession and use of shopping carts on Oʻahu unless the shopping cart is identified by the legal owner and used on a premises under the legal control of the owner. Establishes penalties. Defines shopping cart to include metal or plastic handcarts on three or more wheels, and to exclude handcarts made out of other materials, without sides (flatbeds), or with a carrying capacity of less than 1 .41 cubic feet or 40 liters (baskets with wheels).

Status: CCL/PH → PUBLISH

Latest action: Second reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
